source_text: Non enim omnes qui ex Israel, hi sunt Israelitae; neque quia sunt semen Abrahae, omnes filii. In Isaac vocabitur tibi semen — non filii carnis hi filii Dei.
pass_a_gloss: For not all who are from Israel, these are Israelites; nor because they are seed of Abraham, all children. In Isaac shall seed be called to you — not the children of flesh, these are children of God.
pass_b_english: [[Not all who are descended from Israel belong to Israel >> Bible:Romans 9:6]]. [[Not all are children of Abraham because they are his offspring >> Bible:Romans 9:7]] — [[Through Isaac shall your offspring be named >> Bible:Romans 9:7]].
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
